why: rc31: second review of NPC names, zone names and spell texts

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc31 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Second full review of the names and texts, done by meaning, not by sound.
NPC names: 1277 names re-read and corrected (word order like "dustbelcher wyrmhunter", animal and job words, no made-up fused words). Clan and place names that are translated by meaning stay as they were.
Zone names: 161 corrected. Barrens, Badlands, Hinterlands, Shadowglen and a few other zones were left as before on purpose (checked later).
Spell and talent descriptions: 71 sentences improved.
Includes rc7 to rc30.

Data from ForeverDB.net
